scenarios.preReviewSubject: Duke ’29: Questions About the Morrow & Pike Sophomore Program
scenarios.preReviewBody:
Hi Olivia,

My name is Maya Okafor, and I'm a sophomore studying Economics at Duke University, graduating in 2029. I'm writing to you as Morrow & Pike's campus recruiter and a fellow Duke alum.

This past summer I interned at Pinecrest Wealth Partners, where I built a screening model for 40 dividend stocks used in client portfolio reviews. On campus, I'm a consumer sector analyst in the Duke Investment Club.

I had two questions about the sophomore program. First, when does the application usually open? Second, does the program feed into the summer analyst class?

My resume is attached. Thank you very much for your time!

Best,
